Live burden: The defender must substantiate every intrinsic plurality's unifying-ground requirement, then show why God cannot primitively or reflexively ground that unity without circularity. Locked score: The supplied very-strong placement rewards focused responsiveness, conceptual precision, calibrated phrasing, and dialectical progress, while acknowledging that the ontology of unity remains incompletely defended.
